subject.title: [Bug]: macOS app 'Launch at login' stops sticking / appears to turn itself off after app updates

question: Should the macOS app persist OpenClaw-owned Launch at login intent and re-register the app LaunchAgent after updates when launchd state drifts?
rationale: Current code treats live launchd state as authoritative for the toggle, while the report asks for user intent to survive app replacement/update; choosing the authority affects upgrade semantics and user control.

options.title: Persist intent and reconcile drift
options.body: Store explicit in-app enablement and repair only the app-owned LaunchAgent after startup/update drift, with guards for deliberate external disablement.

options.title: Keep launchd authoritative
options.body: Treat launchd/macOS state as the only source of truth and update UI or docs so the app does not restore externally disabled login items.

options.title: Wait for live update proof
options.body: Keep this parked until a packaged Sparkle update repro shows exactly which state flips before selecting repair behavior.

recommendation.title: Persist intent and reconcile drift
recommendation.body: Store explicit in-app enablement and repair only the app-owned LaunchAgent after startup/update drift, with guards for deliberate external disablement.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history on the launchd-backed checkbox path and current macOS app state files.
